scope: Production publication and verification of the PhiAgent GitHub Star call-to-action
summary: PR 7 published the focused GitHub Star call-to-action on the existing PhiAgent demo page. GitHub Pages deployed successfully, and production browser acceptance confirms the live count, repository link, post-click Star guidance, responsive layout, and error-free runtime.
evidence: GitHub Pages workflow run 31498304255 completed successfully for the merge commit.
The production URL returns HTTP 200 with Last-Modified Tue, 11 Aug 2026 13:50:48 GMT and contains the support card, GitHub repository URL, Star-count fetch, and post-click instruction.
A real production browser loaded the current GitHub Star count as 8 and resolved the button to https://github.com/YuhuaJiang2002/PhiAgent.
Activating the production button changes the guidance to tell the visitor to click Star in the repository page's upper-right corner.
Production desktop and 390x844 mobile visual checks show the complete card and button without clipping.
Production browser logs contain no warnings or errors.
lessons: A GitHub Star call-to-action can provide a durable like path on a static site without adding a backend or falsely treating a navigation click as a completed vote.
Production acceptance should verify deployment provenance, live DOM state, the external destination, dynamic count, responsive rendering, and runtime logs.
limitations: The visible count depends on GitHub's unauthenticated repository API and can temporarily fall back to a GitHub label if rate-limited.
Only GitHub can confirm whether an individual visitor completed the Star action after navigation.
